facts.fact: 报纸头条：又一名女生在“学生谋杀公寓”中被杀。
facts.anchor: SECOND GIRL KILLED IN STUDENT MURDER FLAT

facts.fact: Gloria 从报纸得知又一名学生死在 Emily Pierce 的旧宅。
facts.anchor: Another student had been killed in Emily Pierce’s old house.

facts.fact: 报道引警方称两案无关联证据，但保持开放态度。
facts.anchor: Police say they have no evidence the two killings are connected but are keeping an open mind.

facts.fact: 她随即闪回 2000 年 1 月 4 日警察上门的那天。
facts.anchor: Inevitably, her mind took her back to 4 January 2000 again.

facts.fact: 她承认前天从藏处取出并销毁了 Aiden 那个会连累他的信封。
facts.anchor: That’s why I took your idiotic incriminating envelope from its incredibly obvious hiding place and destroyed it

facts.fact: Aiden 说 Olivia Kavanagh 突然给他发邮件，他因此去见了她。
facts.anchor: She emailed me out of the blue

facts.fact: Gloria 指责他见过那女孩后女孩就死了，和 Emily 一样。
facts.anchor: You went to meet this girl and now she’s dead. Just like Emily.

facts.fact: 通话后她恐慌发作，倒在地上。
facts.anchor: Then the tiles came up to meet her face
